dedupe_keys.name: danish energy agency technology catalogues techno economic data for energy technologies

description: The Danish Energy Agency Technology Catalogues are the agency's published and regularly updated catalogues of technology data, giving technology, economy and environment information for energy installations, used by the agency for its energy projections. They hold general representative techno-economic values, not project-specific offers, and are separated into eight categories: generation of electricity and district heating, individual heating plants, renewable fuels, carbon capture, transport and storage, energy storage, industrial process heat, transport of energy, and commercial freight and passenger transport. The electricity and district heating catalogue covers centralised and decentralised production, was first published in August 2016 and was updated in August 2026, with Excel data sheets per technology and technology briefs on solar photovoltaics, large heat pumps, geothermal and boilers, and offshore wind. Chapters are created through an open process with stakeholder consultations. Coverage is Denmark with wide international use. Access: PDF catalogues and Excel sheets on the agency site, free. Caveats: values should not be the sole basis for investment decisions, and some technology descriptions date from 2015. It suits energy system capacity planning and optimisation inputs, and relates to the Mopo industry technology catalogue catalogued here.
